🏢 Social Media for Business Owners · Lesson 2 of 4

The Cold-Start Problem: Google Business Profile and Your First 10 Reviews

6 min read · Updated November 2026 · Free · Written for Kenya
Share: WhatsApp X Facebook Telegram LinkedIn

The most powerful free tool for a Kenyan shop isn't on Instagram or TikTok. It's the listing that appears when someone types "salon near me" — and most small businesses never claim it.

Every new business has the same problem: no reviews, no followers, no proof. Customers would rather be your tenth buyer than your first. You break that loop by being findable and by collecting proof on purpose — not by waiting.

Step 1: Claim your Google Business Profile

It's free, and it puts you on Google Maps and local search. Google's own help page says customers are 70% more likely to visit and 50% more likely to consider buying from businesses with a complete profile. Complete means: correct category, hours, photos, phone or WhatsApp, and a description in plain words.

70%
more likely to visit a business with a complete Business Profile (Google Business Profile Help)
💡 What most owners miss

The category matters more than the description. "Hair salon" vs "Beauty salon" vs "Barber shop" changes which searches you show up in. Pick the most specific primary category, then add 1–2 secondary ones. Also add photos regularly — a profile that looks updated reads as a business that's still open.

Step 2: Engineer your first 10 reviews

  • Ask the same day, while the experience is fresh — at the counter or in the delivery WhatsApp chat.
  • Send the direct review link (from your Google profile's "Ask for reviews" button), not "search for us on Google".
  • Reply to every review, good or bad, within 48 hours. Owners who reply look present.
  • Never buy fake reviews or review your own business — Google removes them and it can hurt your listing.
📋 Review request (WhatsApp)
Hi [Name]! Asante for buying [product] from [Business] today 🙏
If you're happy with it, would you leave us a quick Google review? It really helps small businesses like ours get found:
[your review link]
It takes 30 seconds. And if anything wasn't right, tell me here first so I can fix it.
✗ MYTH

Reviews matter less now that everyone uses TikTok and Instagram.

✓ REALITY

BrightLocal's 2025 research still found Google is consumers' preferred review platform, even as social media gains influence. Your social page gets attention; your Google profile often gets the final check before someone visits.

✅ Do this today
⚡ Quick check

You're setting up a Google Business Profile. Which field most affects which searches you appear in?

The primary category tells Google what kind of business you are, so it shapes which 'near me' searches you're matched to. Choose the most specific one.

🧠 Key takeaways
  1. Claim your free Google Business Profile before spending on ads.
  2. Google says complete profiles get 70% more visits and 50% more purchase consideration.
  3. The primary category quietly decides which searches you show up in.
  4. Ask for reviews the same day, with a direct link, and answer every one.
